key_insight: CODA combines patient-cohort patterns with individual deviations to support multimodal clinical reasoning.
clinical_relevance: This approach aims to contextualize patient-specific information within similar patient groups for clinical question answering and report generation.
method: Uses reinforcement learning to discover patient cohorts.
Represents each patient's deviation from a cohort prototype as a structured drift signal.
Incorporates cohort and drift representations into a multimodal foundation model.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports consistent effectiveness and strong generalizability on real-world EHR benchmarks covering closed-QA, open-QA, and report generation, but provides no numerical results.
watch_item: Benchmark results alone do not establish clinical safety or performance across new hospitals and patient populations.
paper_title: CODA: Cohort- and Drift-aware Foundation Model for Multimodal Clinical Reasoning
